t.Arriba, tipo y bróker en una línea, los: At the top, type and broker on one line, the four buttons in one row on mobile and the price date explained (funds have one price a day). Averages and RSI are folded into «For the curious» and the fund manager shows its name.
t.GrowFolio IA tiene una regla nueva: nada: GrowFolio AI has a new rule: no unexplained jargon, and start with what it means for you. You'll notice it in the next reports and answers.
t.En el Paso a paso, lo de Hacienda sale e: In Step by step, the tax part shows in one sentence and the rest under «More on taxes». News groups its sources («Yahoo Finance (#)») and the «Good» and «Bad» tags no longer stretch across.
t.El riesgo de # a # dice que # es lo más: Risk from # to # says # is the riskiest and the AI's score is called «Risk control» (# is best). In Goals, empty «not given» rows no longer show until you fill in your profile, and when selling you see how many units you have.
